content: This paper presents a new method for **joint feature selection and classification** of **longitudinal (functional) data** with categorical outcomes, combining logistic loss with functional principal components and an adaptive **Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm** to handle high-dimensional settings efficiently. Its effectiveness is validated through simulations and a real-world case study linking **four chronic diseases** to health and socio-demographic factors, demonstrating scalability even when features outnumber observations.
